value_unit: unchecked endpoints stay outside active pool
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: The donor pool requires a measured positive latency before membership. LumiNet planner incorrectly dispatched zero-observation endpoints; the target-native fix requires at least one successful observation.
invariant: dispatch eligibility requires actual successful evidence; unknown and failed-only endpoints remain visible but inactive
negative_invariant: never infer dispatch authority from an unobserved endpoint
license_note: no explicit repository license; no direct source reuse, idea/guardrail only

separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: The donor backs off relay failures. LumiNet polling relays previously retried failed empty polls every ticker interval. The target-native shared relay state now applies cancellation-aware capped exponential failure backoff and resets on success.
invariant: repeated upstream failure backs off in one shared relay owner and successful communication resets debt
negative_invariant: a failed relay must not be hammered at the steady-state poll cadence
license_note: no explicit repository license; no direct source reuse, idea/guardrail only

value_unit: DoH failure falls back to system DNS
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: Donor fallback can leak names to system DNS after privacy-path failure. LumiNet already fails closed for malformed/privacy-proxied encrypted DNS and keeps that stronger behavior.
invariant: privacy-selected encrypted DNS never silently downgrades to system DNS because its proxy path failed
negative_invariant: no privacy-mode direct/system fallback
license_note: no explicit repository license; no direct source reuse, idea/guardrail only

value_unit: local CA MITM and generated leaf certificates
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: Installing/generated MITM trust would enlarge LumiNet authority and contradict its strict PKI-or-explicit-pin transport model.
invariant: PKI verification is default; explicit pinning is narrow and never silently replaced by local interception
negative_invariant: do not create/install a CA or forge destination certificates for ordinary client transport
license_note: no explicit repository license; no direct source reuse, idea/guardrail only

value_unit: TLS fragmentation and out-of-band packet variants
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: LumiNet already owns fragmentation/evasion in its established proxy/evasion plane; donor packaging would duplicate authority and has no explicit license.
invariant: one evasion configuration owner composes supported transport variations
negative_invariant: no donor-specific second evasion runtime
license_note: no explicit repository license; no direct source reuse, idea/guardrail only

separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: Existing runtimecore and process supervisor provide target-native lifecycle ownership and rollback; another process manager would split authority.
invariant: one lifecycle authority owns start/replace/restore/stop
negative_invariant: no donor-specific process manager authority
license_note: no explicit repository license; no direct source reuse, idea/guardrail only

value_unit: two-stage quick scan plus repeated deep qualification
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: Two-stage qualification is sound, but LumiNet already uses bounded repeated handshake/quality sampling with loss, median RTT, jitter and strict concurrency/candidate caps.
invariant: quality decisions use bounded repeated evidence rather than one ping
negative_invariant: scanner must not use insecure TLS or unbounded worker fanout
license_note: MIT/permissive; direct adaptation allowed with attribution when selected

separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: Scanner reachability evidence must not become transport trust. LumiNet records TLS evidence separately and keeps live transports verified.
invariant: diagnostic probing may record evidence but may not grant live transport authority
negative_invariant: no InsecureSkipVerify in user-traffic paths
license_note: MIT/permissive; direct adaptation allowed with attribution when selected

separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: A single ping is weaker than LumiNet loss-aware multi-sample median/jitter scoring and can select flaky endpoints.
invariant: selection evidence preserves loss and distribution shape
negative_invariant: never promote one lucky ping over repeated quality evidence
license_note: MIT/permissive; direct adaptation allowed with attribution when selected

value_unit: round-robin per-stream shaper with per-stream priority heap
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: Fair per-stream scheduling is valuable and may improve KCP multiplexing, but replacing xtaci/smux with a fork requires protocol-compatibility and measured differential evidence. No dependency swap is justified in this pass.
invariant: a future mux replacement must prove compatibility, fairness, memory bounds and throughput under the same workload
negative_invariant: do not swap a central mux dependency from static code preference alone
license_note: MIT/permissive; direct adaptation allowed with attribution when selected

value_unit: validated frame/session/stream receive buffers and keepalive deadlines
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: The donor makes bounds explicit. LumiNet currently relies on the pinned xtaci/smux implementation/defaults; a future upgrade must verify equivalent bounds rather than copying fork internals.
invariant: multiplexed sessions remain bounded and keepalive timeouts are coherent
negative_invariant: no unbounded per-stream buffering
license_note: MIT/permissive; direct adaptation allowed with attribution when selected

value_unit: stateless retry and explicit connection limit
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: Useful QUIC server admission semantics, but qtun is a separate TCP-over-QUIC server role; LumiNet does not need another server authority.
invariant: new inbound QUIC authority requires explicit admission/resource limits
negative_invariant: do not create a second relay/server role solely to mirror donor capabilities

value_unit: SCM_RIGHTS socket protect with 3s read/write timeouts
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: The mechanism is sound for Android VpnService integration, but LumiNet mobile ownership already lives in its Android/mobile adapter plane; introducing a Rust-side second protect path would duplicate platform authority.
invariant: one platform owner decides VPN socket protection
negative_invariant: no second JNI/Unix protect authority

value_unit: Tor bootstrap/control events and transfer/circuit measurement schema
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: OnionPerf provides mature measurement vocabulary (bootstrap, transfer error, circuit path/build timing) that is valuable for future Tor diagnostics, but it is a measurement framework rather than a runtime owner.
invariant: future Tor performance telemetry should remain read-only, bounded and tied to the existing SAFECOOKIE controller
negative_invariant: measurement must not create another Tor process/control authority
license_note: BSD-style U.S. Government redistribution terms; reference/independent derivation permitted per terms

value_unit: RTT estimation and Tor cell-trace transduction methodology
separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: This is offline privacy-research methodology useful for evaluation design, not production routing. No live trace-retention/fingerprinting plane is justified.
invariant: privacy evaluation may be offline and explicit; production traffic should not be retained merely to mimic research datasets
negative_invariant: no passive trace collection authority introduced
license_note: BSD-style U.S. Government redistribution terms; reference/independent derivation permitted per terms

separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: The donor itself documents memory cost and increased compromised-circuit probability. LumiNet retains one supervised Tor engine plus circuit rotation/bridges rather than multiplying processes.
invariant: one supervised Tor process owns client runtime unless a future multi-instance design proves anonymity and resource benefits
negative_invariant: do not equate more Tor processes with stronger anonymity

separability: standalone semantic contribution
decision_rationale: LumiNet does not currently ship a production DNS tunnel and truthfully reports that mode unavailable.
